scenarios.title: A purchase above the co-sign line needs a second adult
scenarios.proves: Pip's 160 waits on Unichain until Bob co-signs; only then is it spent and counted by Hob

scenarios.title: Pip must say why
scenarios.proves: a buy with no reason is refused; a buy with one carries Pip's words on-chain, in the same transaction as the money

scenarios.title: The adults change a rule mid-period
scenarios.proves: a new cap ratified on Base reaches Unichain by callback, no admin involved

scenarios.title: A paused category is closed on every chain
scenarios.proves: rent paused on Base is refused on Unichain, then reopened the same way

scenarios.title: Removing a member works everywhere
scenarios.proves: Pip voted out on Base is refused on Unichain, then voted back in

scenarios.title: Hob's pace limit is exact
scenarios.proves: 6 buys across chains pass, the 7th freezes Pip on both chains

scenarios.title: One payment can close a category
scenarios.proves: a single rent payment of the whole cap freezes rent on both chains; groceries stay open
